Very Good service 💪
Sep 2023 • Family
Hadilao is a standout for its exceptional customer service. Although there is often a long wait time, customers don’t mind thanks to the various amenities offered while waiting, such as snacks, tea, ice cream, free nail services, and photo printing. I’ve visited all the branches in Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, and Guangzhou, China, and have consistently received excellent service. While the food is generally well-prepared, adding a bit more pork to the menu would make it even better. The ginseng hot pot broth is truly fantastic.

its ok, little pricy
Apr 2024 • Couples
Haidilao Hot Pot is a well-known Chinese chain that has gained popularity worldwide. Let’s break down the key aspects of our visit:

Fresh Ingredients and Flavorful Broth: The food at Haidilao lives up to its reputation. The tomato and chicken soup base are particularly delicious. Don’t miss out on the prawn paste, which adds a delightful twist to your hot pot experience.
Service Excellence: Haidilao is renowned for its exceptional service. From providing manicures to offering aprons and handphone plastic covers, they go the extra mile. The attentive wait staff also prepare your food tableside. It’s a great place to enjoy a meal with friends or family.
Hidden Costs and Price Value: While the overall experience is positive, it’s essential to note that Haidilao isn’t cheap. Expect to spend at least $35 per person. The soup base alone costs $20! Additionally, there are hidden costs such as sauces ($4) and drinks ($3 per person), so factor those into your bill.
In summary, Haidilao Hot Pot offers a flavorful journey, excellent service, and a cozy ambiance. If you’re willing to splurge a bit, it’s worth a visit.

5 points for everything but minus two points for…
Aug 2022 • Friends
While waiting, you have free drinks, fresh fruits, snacks, ice cream and even free nail painting. The service is quick and clear to understand on how to order your dishes for the hotpot. Many choices of meats, seafood and vegetables. Even the additional 40,000VND/psn for dipping sauces is worth it. Desserts are lacking in choices, but by the end of the hotpot meal, who cares! Definitely choose fresh noodles with your hotpot so you can enjoy the mesmerizing noodles dance. Expect about $20/psn with drinks. Bring along a pair of earplugs. The music for entertainment is excruciatingly loud to the point of pain. Sorry Haidilao, I knocked off 2 points for the deafening music during your 10 minutes of some sort of entertainment. 🥴

This was our first visit here, we found this by accident after visiting the heli bar. We were unsure about this type of food as we had never tried it. Lots of locals eating here so that is always a good sign. Great value for money and we won't walk away hungry.

Modern and Delicious
Jan 2020
I went there with a friend late last night and was pleasantly surprised at the quality of the meal.
The food is brought to you and you basically cook it yourself, dipping the various foods in different types of stock.
What was really cool is that when you order (from an iPad) an automated delivery cart comes with the food on it. It is radar controlled so it doesn't even bump into people on the way, and I think it even says "excuse me" if it approaches you.
The quality of the food is great with lots of choices.
Highly recommended.
